text: FAA guidance urges reestablishing the control link and, if it cannot be reestablished, initiating emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link. It also requires describing actions for loss of control link during risk assessment and recommends discontinuing flight until inspection if control link issues arise. The DJI Matrice 4T manual states the craft will auto-Failsafe RTH when the remote signal is lost, and notes a 50 m backward move on the original route before Preset RTH if the RTH distance exceeds 50 m; it also records that Failsafe RTH is triggered when the link is lost.
